summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 12, 2026, announcing publication in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy (a Nature Portfolio journal) of preclinical research showing piclidenoson improved a kidney disease marker by 48-80% in Lowe syndrome models. No transaction, capital event, or governance change is disclosed. The company notes a planned open-label Phase II trial in five adults is under review by Italian health authorities. This is a routine scientific/clinical disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply. Watch only for regulatory clearance and trial initiation.
